text:
Anna G: Heads up — planning to cut the 1.15 branch tomorrow at 17:00 UTC. Who's available to own branch creation + initial smoke?
Ramon P: I can do the branch creation and push the initial changelog bump. Need someone to watch the CI runs.
Sasha L: I can monitor CI for the first hour. Ping me when the PR is open. :eyes:
Anna G: @Ramon P please also add the `changelog/draft` entry and mark the PR with `backport-candidate` label. We want backport requests to funnel through a single queue.
Ramon P: Will do. Quick Q on backport policy — do we still require a manual approval for cherry-picks touching infra/ops packages?
Sasha L: Yes — infra/ops changes need a maintainer signoff from eng-infra. For other packages, maintainers can approve.
Jules: Tiny clarification: for user-facing bugfixes we accept direct cherry-picks into release/* as long as they have tests + changelog line and are marked `backport-ready`. For anything touching migrations or tooling, escalate.
Anna G: Good. Also reminder: cutoff for accepting new features is 15:00 UTC tomorrow. After that only bugfixes with a clear regression/QA signoff.
Elena M: Product request — can someone add a short blurb to the changelog about the telemetry opt-out flag? Can't ship without that note. I can draft the blurb and paste here.
Ramon P: please paste the blurb here, I'll drop it into the changelog draft in the branch.
Elena M: "Telemetry: add --telemetry-opt-out to disable anonymous usage reporting. See docs PR #1423 for details."
Ramon P: Added. Creating branch now: 
```
git checkout -b release/1.15
git push origin release/1.15
# open PR: repo:main -> release/1.15, add labels: changelog/draft, backport-candidate
```
release-bot: Automated note — release/1.15 branch created by Ramon P at 2028-04-12T17:05:32Z. CI started (sha: b7f3c9). :robot_face:
Sasha L: CI looks green on linux/amd64, flaky test on macos that I'll rerun.
Anna G: Once CI is green, we'll do a quick smoke on staging. @Sasha L can you coordinate?
Sasha L: On it — will run smoke and post results in this thread.
Jules: Backport requests: please include the original PR link, target branch (release/1.15), and add `requires-backport` label. I'll triage them as they come.
Ramon P: One more ops note: if a cherry-pick conflicts, prefer a manual recreate rather than `git cherry-pick -x` automated conflict resolution. Call me if you hit a tough one.
Anna G: Thanks all. Final checklist for tomorrow: [x] branch created, [ ] changelog draft final, [ ] CI smoke, [ ] backport queue triage. I'll reopen thread once smoke completes. :shipit:
Sasha L: Smoke done — basic flows passing on staging, will run extended tests tonight and report back. :white_check_mark:
Jules: Started watching `backport` label now. Tag me for anything urgent. :bell:
release-bot: Reminder scheduled — cutoff for features at 2028-04-12T15:00:00Z (UTC).
Anna G: Closing the loop — everything looks good for the cut. Thanks team.
